workUnits.requiredOutcome: The JTest C# build gate is established and active: the Orbyss.ProgramKit.GeneratedSourceContract.Analyzers package is packed into the local feed and pinned, the gate definition validates and binds through the backed csharp-gate operations per the approved activation matrix, and csharp-gate verify passes with the selection lock and activation evidence committed.
allowedEdits: tools/prepare-program-kit-feed.ps1; packages/local-feed.manifest.json; Directory.Packages.props; src/JTest.Cli.Host project gate wiring; governance/; a new gate/ artifact directory for the definition, selection lock, and evidence; focused tests.
stopConditions: Stop if the backed csharp-gate operations reject the definition, the analyzer package cannot be packed from Program Kit commit 773d7cf, or activation would require any PKCS-private Program Kit component on consumer source.

verification.expectedObservation: Zero warnings and zero errors with the gate components active per the activation matrix; csharp-gate verify exits 0 and its evidence is committed.

workUnits.requiredOutcome: JTest.Cli carries the consumer console contracts in a new Console/ intent area: typed run/validate/describe request classes, handler interfaces and implementations adapting the existing command classes unchanged, IJTestRunValidator holding run's input pre-checks, and the single JTestCliShellFeature registering them; CShells 0.0.28 is pinned; application logic in JTest.Language/Engine/Reporting is untouched.
allowedEdits: src/JTest.Cli/Console/**; src/JTest.Cli/Commands/RunCliCommand.cs (moving input pre-checks only); src/JTest.Cli/JTest.Cli.csproj; Directory.Packages.props (CShells pin); tests/JTest.Cli.Tests/**.
stopConditions: Stop if the contract shapes required by generation metadata inspection cannot be expressed without changing JTest.Language, JTest.Engine, or JTest.Reporting, or without altering command behavior.

verification.expectedObservation: Unit tests cover the validator move (invalid inputs report through the validator result) and handler adaptation; full solution green with the gate active.

workUnits.requiredOutcome: The generated host is fully replaced: tools/JTest.HostInputs authors the Open Console document (grammar unchanged), the new binding document over the compiled JTest.Cli contracts, and the generation request; tools/generate-cli-host.ps1 uses refresh-host with --build-consumer; the dispatcher-era tree in src/JTest.Cli.Host is deleted and the typed Spectre host generated in its place, packaged as the jtest tool, with the frozen CLI behavior (exit codes 0-3 from evidence, report URL, auto-open) preserved.
allowedEdits: hosting/**; tools/JTest.HostInputs/**; tools/generate-cli-host.ps1; src/JTest.Cli.Host/** (full replacement); JTest.sln; tests/JTest.Cli.Tests/**; tests/JTest.AcceptanceTests/** (assertion adaptation to Spectre-rendered messages only).
stopConditions: Stop if the binding or generation contracts cannot express part of the frozen jtest grammar or exit map, or if the generated project leaves no consumer-owned seam for dotnet-tool packaging.

verification.expectedObservation: The process-level exit-code matrix passes against the new generated binary: pass 0, failing suite 1, invalid input/unknown option/no files 2, describe byte-equal to the embedded manifest, report URL printed, auto-open suppressed under CI.

workUnits.requiredOutcome: Closure: program-kit dotnet verify-host guards the generated tree from the acceptance suite (tamper evidence), the consumption-boundary tests cover the new packages, documentation (cli.md, program-kit-tool.md compatibility table, release-readiness addendum) reflects the typed host, and the full suite is green twice consecutively.
stopConditions: Stop if verify-host reports drift the regeneration flow cannot explain, or any acceptance regression traces to changed application-layer behavior.

verification.expectedObservation: Full suite green including the new verify-host tamper test; a byte-flip in any generated file makes the suite fail.

trace.implementationOutcome: The dispatcher-era generated host is fully replaced by the typed Spectre host generated from the Open Console document, binding document, and compiled contracts via refresh-host.
trace.observableAcceptanceOutcome: The generated binary passes the process-level exit-code matrix with the frozen grammar and exit map.

trace.implementationOutcome: verify-host guards the generated tree from the acceptance suite so tampering fails the build.

trace.implementationOutcome: The frozen CLI behavior is preserved: commands, options, exit codes 0-3 from evidence, report URL line, auto-open semantics, diagnostics formats.

unresolvedDecisions.question: Should a consumer-owned analyzer be designed for the review-enforced governance rules (one type per file, fresh-receiver ban, static helpers, writer purity)? Recommendation: defer to a later design-csharp-build-gate iteration.
